items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: me and Frog, (that was his nickname.)

ctx.x: Oh, a lot of guys were trying to steal him from the band?

Yeah. But Duke laid so much bread on him, not a chance. Then he loved everybody in the band. Especially Ben Webster, he loved Ben Webster. Ben would take him everywhere and show him off to people. Of course, Benny always had somewhere to go, you know, different sections, different clubs. And he'd sic Jimmy on them. Jimmy wasn't wild like me and Ben, me and Frog, (that was his nickname.) But

he was something else, man.
I remember -- I told you about that, the guys who tried to get him away from us in California, Wanted to marry his daughter.
